copies.title: Copies
copies.none: No file is present twice in this project.
copies.candidatesNote: These files carry the same fingerprint: their bytes are identical, and that is measured. Whether a copy is redundant is not — nothing is removed here unless you ask, one row at a time.
copies.sameBytes: {{count, number}} files carry exactly the same bytes
copies.wouldFree: Keeping a single copy would give back {{size}}
copies.cacheNote: The studio makes these files again when it needs them. Stills picked by hand, durable resources and unsaved work are not among them and are never touched.
copies.purgeBusy: The studio is making files right now. Try again once the imports are done.
copies.forgotten: Records brought up to date: {{count, number}}
copies.reopen: Reopen the project so the studio makes again what it needs.
